description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—across varying numbers of tokens, with the x-axis representing the "Number of Tokens" on a linear scale ranging from 200 to 800, marked at intervals of 200, and the y-axis representing a performance metric ranging from 10 to 40. The blue line, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 24 and increases to about 30, showing a steady upward trend. The red line, representing Library Documentation, begins at around 27 and rises to approximately 33, also showing a consistent increase. The yellow line, representing StackOverflow posts, starts at about 34 and decreases sharply to around 13, indicating a significant decline as the number of tokens increases. The green line, representing Github files, starts at approximately 28 and increases to about 33, showing a moderate upward trend. Overall, the plot shows that the performance of Tutorials, Library Documentation, and Github files improves with more tokens, while the performance of StackOverflow posts declines.
